detail.longDescription: Hi HN! I built an embedded db in Rust, that has 100% feature parity with SQLite, and is 500% faster overall than SQLite. It also features built in integration with embedding models, embed functions, vector search, reranker, and other RAG capabilities. It's 100% free and open source. I'd love to hear back from the community, and find some collaborators who are interested in working together! https://github.com/Black-Rainbow-Labs/Inillucent
